trigger: Early BCSS tissue requests repeatedly failed the joint Planner contract because Terra omitted mandatory skill rule IDs or copied the selected pathology mechanism ID into the cell mechanism_program_id field. Case r2de6-005 then abstained after deterministic replanning repeated the same contract failure.
scope: The joint Planner packet now lists mandatory compatibility rule IDs explicitly and says to copy the skill-compiled cell layout into both layout_program_id and mechanism_program_id. The output schema restricts those two skill-owned fields and selected_mechanism_id to the already selected skill values. A second observed contract error showed Terra selecting cell classes outside the primitive contract, so the allowable class IDs are now explicitly intersected from the selected primitive and mechanism and used as the cell-class schema enum. The Planner still selects the certified interface, anchor and other allowed variable choices; no raster, candidate, budget, source case, mask gate or independent E rule changes.
timing_rule: A case process that imported the module before deployment keeps the old packet and schema. A case process started after deployment uses the amended packet. Per-case start time and queue prompt digest distinguish the two. Initial outcomes are retained; failed frozen cases may be retried only as the same case, with an explicit attempt link.
verification: A targeted unittest confirmed that the packet carries mandatory compatibility IDs, binds the two cell program fields to the skill-compiled layout, and restricts cell classes to the primitive–mechanism intersection. The broader 13-test planner selection ran 12 passes and one unrelated existing breast fixture composition error before the class-constraint update; no claim of full-suite pass is made.
